problem_statement: Z_HEAP_MIN_SIZE is documented as the minimum heap size that allows a successful 1-byte allocation, but with runtime statistics enabled (CONFIG_SYS_HEAP_RUNTIME_STATS=y) the runtime-stats bookkeeping enlarges the heap's internal control structure, so a heap of Z_HEAP_MIN_SIZE bytes is too small and a 1-byte allocation cannot be served. When CONFIG_SYS_HEAP_RUNTIME_STATS=y, Z_HEAP_MIN_SIZE must be increased so that a heap of exactly Z_HEAP_MIN_SIZE bytes can successfully allocate 1 byte, while a heap of Z_HEAP_MIN_SIZE - 1 bytes cannot (its initialisation must fail). The non-runtime-stats value must remain valid too.
